description: Dividend-adjusted Yahoo history with optional local SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, or Bollinger studies; not a current quote. A study series carries only the values it has. Each series values[i] is the study value for the bar at prices.date[firstPriceIndex + i]; earlier bars are warm-up and have no value.

endDate.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Defaults to today.

limit.description: Most recent rows to return. Defaults to 120.

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Defaults to one year before endDate. The inclusive range spans at most 4000 calendar days, whatever the interval.

studies.description: Optional studies from adjusted closes; kind is SMA, EMA, RSI, BBANDS or MACD, uppercase. Defaults: period 14; MACD 12/26/9; Bollinger deviations 2.

name: read_price_history
